scientific_question: Is source-to-target transferability of post-IBD spatial genetic structure predictable from a pre-outcome ecological relationship between the source and target species?

separation.unconditional_result: immutable; no rescue, retune, rerun, or reinterpretation
separation.conditional_order_v02: immutable NOT_EVALUABLE survivor-geometry deployment; no tuning against that failure
separation.exploratory_pair_structure: motivation only; any species whose pair-specific response was inspected for hypothesis generation must be excluded from the fresh confirmatory universe

hypothesis.response: T_st: source-only to target post-IBD transfer skill under a fixed transfer operator
hypothesis.primary_predictor: R_st: continuous environmental-niche similarity frozen from external data before genetic response
controls: P_st broad lineage or phylogenetic proximity

primary_relation.candidate_metric: Schoener's D in a common frozen environmental PCA space
primary_relation.authorization_condition: response-blind occurrence/environment feasibility census followed by explicit metric freeze

secondary_relations.host_resource: separate prospectively frozen taxon-applicable secondary protocol only

candidate_families: source/target-label permutation preserving frozen dyadic geometry
inference.selection_basis: synthetic Type-I/power and response-blind geometry only

fresh_panel_firewall.development_panel: external ecology + geometry + synthetic worlds only; genetic response closed
fresh_panel_firewall.confirmatory_panel: species-disjoint one-shot empirical opening after all gates pass

gates.private_null_type1: Wilson95 upper <= 0.10 in every frozen null cell
gates.relational_power: Wilson95 lower >= 0.80 at frozen minimally meaningful relational effect

prohibited: select host/resource/habitat relation after inspecting fresh genetic response
choose similarity threshold from fresh genetic response
change panel composition because of T_st
replace the continuous dyad hypothesis with a favorable taxonomic subgroup after opening
use this study to rescue the completed unconditional result or conditional-order deployment
next_step: response-blind environmental-niche feasibility census on a fresh species universe; do not compute fresh-panel genetic distances or T_st
